summary: Payette NF L-4 ground cab on Nelson Point, Idaho County; destroyed in 1966 by burning in place. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1966; the ground house was removed by burning in place. No source describes what remains.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as a hike-in; no source gives a current route or access status

events.note: University of Idaho archive photo of the Mill Creek Lookout is dated 1930, earlier than the 1934 cab date
Ground house removed by burning in place

evidence.supports: about eight miles northeast of Warren, Idaho County
one site calls it a ground house

evidence.quote: 1966: The L-4 lookout ground house was removed by burning in place.

evidence.supports: archive photo of the Mill Creek Lookout

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two sites give 1934 for the L-4 cab; a University of Idaho archive photo of the Mill Creek Lookout is dated 1930. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick a date.
Destroyed in 1966 (two sites) and removed by burning in place in 1966 (one site) describe the same event in different words.

sources.title: Mill Creek Lookout (Nelson Point)
sources.publisher: Archival Idaho Photograph Collection, University of Idaho Library

notes_for_editor: Three short listings and one archive photo. Fate is consistent (1966). Built year 1934 disagrees with the 1930 photo date and nothing explains it. No staffing history is documented (Idaho Fire Lookouts says so). No source describes the site today. Record location is about 20 m from the archive photo coordinates, so it is fine.
